props.label: About Us
props.heading: Clear vision and stylish confidence
props.body:
Step into a world of clear vision and stylish confidence at Secno Spects — your trusted destination for premium eyewear and expert eye care. Combining advanced eye testing with a wide collection of trendy frames and high-quality lenses, we make sure you see better and look even better.

From classic to contemporary designs, every pair is matched to your personality and comfort. Backed by the trusted care of Shri Eye Care Netralaya, we prioritise precision, quality and customer satisfaction at every step.

We are open all seven days at Omkar Nagar on Besa Road, so an eye test does not have to wait for a day off.

See the world clearly. Style it your way.

props.label: Eye Care
props.heading: What we do
props.sub: Testing, fitting and follow-up — the part of buying glasses that decides whether you actually wear them.

items.title: Comprehensive Eye Test
items.desc: A full vision check covering distance, near, astigmatism and eye coordination, carried out on proper testing equipment rather than a quick chart reading. You leave with your prescription written down.

items.title: Contact Lens Clinic
items.desc: Corneal measurement, trial lenses and a taught insertion-and-care session before you take a box home. Soft, toric and coloured lenses, with follow-up to check the fit is still right.

items.title: Progressive Lens Experts
items.desc: Distance, intermediate and reading in a single lens with no visible line. Fitted from precise pupil-height measurements, which is what decides whether a progressive feels natural or never quite works.

items.title: Scientific Dispensing Optician
items.desc: The frame is fitted to your face and your prescription — pupillary distance, vertex distance, pantoscopic tilt. The same lens in a badly fitted frame is a worse lens, which is where most eyewear complaints come from.

items.title: 100% Satisfaction Guarantee
items.desc: If the glasses are not right, bring them back. We will re-check the prescription, re-fit the frame and remake the lenses where the fault is ours, at no cost.

items.q: Do I need an appointment for an eye test?
items.a: No, walk in any day between 11:00 AM and 9:00 PM. If you would rather not wait, message us on WhatsApp with a time and we will keep a slot for you. Contact lens fittings are best booked ahead as they take longer.

items.q: How long will my glasses take?
items.a: It depends on the lens. Standard single-vision is usually quick; progressives, high powers and specialist coatings are ordered to your measurements and take longer. We will give you a firm date when you order rather than a guess.

items.q: Can I use a prescription from another optician or hospital?
items.a: Yes, as long as it is recent. Bring it with you or send a photo on WhatsApp. If it does not include your pupillary distance we will measure it here.

items.q: Which brands do you stock?
items.a: Over twenty ranges including Denveer, Dynamite, Erski, Eyones, Forgive, Free Fly, Fusionn, Haazel, Illusion, Inspire, Knight Horse, Leo, Life Line, Livelpool, Oreo, Pillars, Qloo, Tag Eye, Titex, Tom Star and Wilton. Stock changes, so message us if you are looking for something specific.

items.q: Do you fit progressive lenses?
items.a: Yes, and it is one of the things we specialise in. A progressive lives or dies on the pupil-height measurement, so we measure it in the frame you have actually chosen rather than working from a standard figure.

items.q: I have never worn contact lenses. Can I start?
items.a: Most people can. You need a fitting first: we measure the curvature of your cornea, trial a lens, and teach you to insert, remove and store them. We will not supply a box to a first-time wearer without that session.

items.q: What if I am not happy with my glasses?
items.a: Bring them back. We will re-check the prescription and re-fit the frame, and where the fault is ours we remake the lenses at no cost.

props.heading: Book an eye test
props.sub: Walk in any day between 11:00 AM and 9:00 PM, or message us on WhatsApp and we will keep a slot for you.
